data.title: 黑歌 · 海礁石上的猫耳比基尼日光浴
data.description: 碧海蓝天之下，黑歌斜卧在海边微温的平滑礁石上，黑色系带比基尼勾勒丰腴曲线，双尾在海风中惬意摆动。
data.action: 斜倚在微热礁石上，单手支颌，双腿微曲交叠，修长黑尾轻扫水花
data.lighting: 耀眼纯净的夏日阳光，海面折射的晶莹水光反衬肌肤
data.camera: 低角度仰视全身，展现修长比例与海天一色
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, kuroka, nekomata, black cat ears, twin tails, two black cat tails, golden eyes, black strappy bikini, cat ear hairpin, reclining on warm coastal sea rock, resting chin on hand, legs gracefully crossed, wet skin glistening in sunlight, ocean waves crashing in background, bright blue sky.
data.animaCaption: 1girl, solo, kuroka, cat ears, two tails, black strappy bikini, reclining on sea rock, glistening in sunlight.
